---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  filter(Year != 2018) |>
  count(Year, name = "attacks") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = attacks)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Shark attacks per year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of attacks"
  )
```
